name: Mirror
summary: Oval wall mirror with a wooden or gold frame and a light reflection streak; anim shine sends a glint across the glass.

params.name: y
params.note: wall item: centred on (x, y); default y = 760 is about eye height on the wall

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the mirror is about 480 px tall

params.name: anim
params.note: shine = a glint slides across the glass

author: krakujs
